description: Live DNS lookup of A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS and TXT records for a domain (a URL is accepted; its hostname is used; IDNs are punycoded). 2 s per query, ~5 s total. Per-record errors are reported in record_errors; if no record resolves at all the call fails and is not charged. Price: $0.01 USDC per call on Base mainnet ($0.001 on Base Sepolia), paid with x402; failed calls are not charged.

hostname.description: Domain name or URL, for example example.com or https://example.com/page.

name: zones.lookup
title: DNS zone lookup
